highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves native-data safety, stream lifetime handling, and platform rendering support.
highlights_body: It also reduces allocation during pixel copies and text shaping, updates Android rendering synchronization, and refreshes platform-native packaging.

bullets.lead: Native data creation respects C-string bounds
bullets.detail: Creating SKData from C strings no longer reads past the native buffer and writes directly into the managed data object.
Corrects stream lifetime handling so front-buffered streams do not retain their underlying data longer than needed.

bullets.lead: Android texture rendering follows display refresh
bullets.detail: Synchronizes Android texture rendering with the display refresh cycle for smoother presentation.

bullets.lead: Image and text processing allocate less
bullets.detail: Optimizes managed pixel copies, HarfBuzz UTF-32 encoding, and native feature-string handling to reduce transient allocation.
Raises the minimum Apple deployment targets used by the packages; update application targets as needed when adopting this release.

bullets.lead: WebGPU support is included in static native assets
bullets.detail: Packages the emdawnwebgpu implementation with libSkiaSharp.a so static consumers have the required WebGPU source.

bullets.lead: Linux resolves bundled HarfBuzz functions locally
bullets.detail: Binds HarfBuzz functions from the bundled native library on Linux, avoiding reliance on an external system binding.

contributor_summaries.VirgilMing: Linux bundled-HarfBuzz binding and improved Blazor CPU sample-test reliability
contributor_summaries.dalexsoto: Addressed contextual PoliCheck findings in continuous integration
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Included the WebGPU implementation in static libSkiaSharp assets
